curated-v1.description: Hand-curated by the textnorm authors from standard usage in printed Talmud, Rishonim and poskim (Shulchan Arukh / Mishnah Berurah). No third-party dictionary text was copied.

meta.not_imported: Wikisource and Dicta abbreviation lists were NOT imported: license/terms were not verified. See README for how to add them.
meta.notes: expansions are ordered most-common-first within the corpus domain; an acronym may have several valid expansions.
meta.priors: prior[domain] in 0..1 = how common this expansion is in that domain. These are HAND ESTIMATES, not corpus counts: derived from the entry's category profile, decayed 0.85 per position in the listed order, with explicit values for the 4 expansions added in v2. Replace with measured frequencies when a tagged corpus is available.

expansions.text: רבי יום טוב בן אברהם אשבילי
